description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans grain directory partition functionality, verifying behaviors such as handling dead silos, preventing duplicate activations, conditional updates, and filtering invalid entries. It includes a mock silo status oracle for testing purposes.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryPartitionTests
classes.description: Unit tests for the Orleans grain directory partition, covering scenarios like dead silo handling, activation conflicts, and conditional updates.

classes.name: MockSiloStatusOracle
classes.description: Mock implementation of ISiloStatusOracle for testing, simulating silo statuses and providing membership info.

methods.name: OverrideDeadEntryTest
methods.description: Verifies that directory entries pointing to dead silos can be overridden with new activations.

methods.name: DoNotInsertInvalidEntryTest
methods.description: Ensures that attempts to register activations on dead silos are rejected.

methods.name: DoNotOverrideValidEntryTest
methods.description: Checks that valid entries are not overridden by new activation attempts.

methods.name: OverrideValidEntryIfMatchesTest
methods.description: Tests conditional update where the previous address matches, allowing an override.

methods.name: DoNotOverrideValidEntryIfNoMatchTest
methods.description: Ensures that conditional updates fail if the previous address does not match the current entry.

methods.name: DoNotReturnInvalidEntryTest
methods.description: Verifies that lookups do not return entries pointing to dead silos.
